summary: Compact IR distance sensor module with a black plastic body. Two mounting ears extend from the ends of the long axis, each with a round hole. The emitter and detector lens windows are on one face. A small PCB with a 3-pin connector protrudes from the opposite edge. Axes: x is the long dimension including the ears, y is the width including the connector tab, and z is the thickness along the sensing direction.

mountingSurfaces.description: Rear face on the PCB side. The ears are flush against a panel here, and the mounting holes pass through them along z.
Front sensing face with the emitter and detector windows. It must stay unobstructed and face the target.

notes: The overall size of 44.5 x 18.9 x 13.5 mm comes from the listed specs and is flagged unverified. No drawing with printed dimensions is visible. The hole diameter (about 3 mm) and the hole positions are estimated from pixel proportions in the rear-view image, not stated, so they should be checked against the datasheet. The axis assignment is an interpretation of the views. The connector and PCB are included in the y extent.
